done_when: A follow-up that names a period the app reads itself (a month with or without a year, a year, a quarter with or without a year, or last, previous or this month, quarter or year) answers for that period whatever window the model emits; fiscal and other wording (FY, YTD, next month, previous week) keeps the model's window and the period control; a question naming no period still inherits or aggregates as before, and an amount is never read as a year; changing an answer's period still re-runs on the chosen period

findings.body: `calendarYear` does not recognize the common `between … and …` comparison form. For example, “Show GL codes whose Actual amount is between 2025 and 3000 rupees” does not match any amount prefix/suffix guard for the first number, so 2025 becomes a full-year window and overrides the model or inherited window. This directly violates the requirement that an amount is never read as a year, and the regression matrix omits amount ranges.
findings.title: Not done: An amount range can still be read as a calendar year

findings.body: The display-granularity stripping fixes “by quarter,” but other common no-period wording remains broken. “Show quarter over quarter Actual” cannot be resolved by either parser, yet the bare `quarter` matches `PERIOD_WORD_PATTERN`; consequently the model-emitted window is neither cleared nor replaced by the prior window. The question names no specific period, so it must inherit or aggregate as required. The added matrix has many display forms but no quarter-over-quarter case.
findings.title: Not done: “quarter over quarter” can preserve the model’s arbitrary window

findings.body: An unambiguous named month such as “Show July/2025” is not accepted by `MONTH_WITH_YEAR_PATTERN`, although numeric month/year and quarter/year slash forms are supported. `parseTimeWindow` also cannot parse it, after which `parseNamedTimeWindow` finds the bare year before considering the month and selects all of 2025. Thus this month-with-year wording answers for the wrong period regardless of the model window. The table covers `07/2025` and `Q3/2025` but omits the named-month equivalent.
findings.title: Not done: A named month/year with a slash is reduced to the whole year

findings.body: The prior coverage gap remains open. The new matrix invokes `ChatService.ask` through `makeFixture`, whose provider, executor/database, audit, dimensions, and resolver are fakes; the period-control test uses the same boundary. The unchanged root test command (`package.json` line 26) runs Node/Vitest suites, while the frontend test script (`frontend/package.json` line 9) is jsdom Vitest and the repository contains no Playwright specification or dependency. Therefore named-period follow-ups, inheritance/aggregation, and edited-period reruns still lack the required browser → running API → real database proof; the successful close run only proves the hermetic tests.
findings.title: Not done: end-to-end Ask coverage for period selection and reruns

why: An Ask question that names a period, such as July 2026, answers for that period even as a follow-up in the same thread; the model's own window and the previous answer's window used to win
